modern: To seek what is impossible is madness: and it is impossible that the bad should not do something of this kind.

explained.summary: It’s madness to want the impossible, and it’s impossible for bad people not to behave badly. Expecting otherwise only sets you up to be upset. Marcus isn’t excusing wrongdoing, just refusing to be surprised by it.
